messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can someone clarify the expected GA window for API v2, the Console UX refresh, and Optimize heuristics? We heard "Q3/Q4" but teams need sequencing + blockers. @Rhonda @Elaine
Rhonda: Topline: API v2 soft-GA targeted for end of Q3 (approx 2026-08-28), Console UX refresh alpha mid-Q4 (2026-11-10), Optimize beta late Q4 (2026-12-15). I'll post a timeline doc after this thread. Main risks below.
Vivek: Can you call out the single biggest risk for each? We need to know if any require cross-org hires or infra buys.
Rhonda: API v2 risk = oauth/enterprise SSO test matrix; failing a test could add ~1 week. Console risk = design polish + accessibility fixes (depends on 2 UX sprints). Optimize risk = regression vs baseline; needs more eval data and compute.
Elaine: Infra note: API v2 perf testing shows 95th latency ~120ms over baseline in staging. To mitigate we need to scale the staging cluster to match prod load and run a 48h soak. I'll open the ticket and tag ops.
Mike: Optimize owner here — we can compress eval time with stratified sampling across the prompt corpus, which halves cost/time but loses edge-case coverage. Proposal: run stratified 10k prompt sample, then a focused sweep on failure modes. Need quick research + product sign-off.
Sam: Does that change launch sequencing? e.g., ship API v2 first then Optimize? Product teams need the ordering so they can plan dependencies.
Rhonda: Sequence we're planning: API v2 -> Console alpha -> Optimize beta. Optimize work can proceed in parallel once API v2 exposes the new telemetry, but Console isn't gated on Optimize.
Vivek: Ok. What about canary windows and rollback plan for API v2? Ops needs specifics to schedule support.
Elaine: Canary plan: 1) internal org (10%) 2) 5 pilot customers 3) ramp to 50% over 72h with automated fallback. Rollback path: immediate traffic cut and model/service fallback to v1, with post-mortem checklist. I'll attach the canary playbook to the ticket.
Sam: Action items captured: @Rhonda -> post milestone table + owners by EOD Fri; @Elaine -> open canary ticket (#12345) and attach playbook; @Mike -> confirm sampling plan with research; I will sync with Sales for pilot customer list.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary run 'canary-api-v2' at 2063460000 — dry-run for infra verification only :robot_face:
Rhonda: :thumbsup: thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to sequencing or the mitigations, flag them here. Otherwise we'll treat this as the post-allhands timeline and push the milestones doc to the roadmap folder.
